items.title: Alcide "Slow Drag" Pavageau Interview, 1958-12-10
items.q: first I used to work for Al Mastricht

ctx.x: Well, I think I would drag you, what other jobs have you done? Slater, different things you used to tell me, what other jobs?

Oh, yeah, I used to work, first I used to work for Al Mastricht, 919 on Lobster Street, and I used to do all the slater work, paper hanging, plaster, that's my tray, and I knew that I'd do carbonate work. And I done all that. I went for D'Alandino real estate at 729 Newton Street. I done all that for D'Alandino real estate. And now I went for Miss Ducco at 1301 Barrett Street. She's dead, and her sister died, and all of them cats are from Miss Ducco. My father and neighbors, my parents used to be at a bigger…
Well, can you tell me, once in New York, when you and George were up there, you told me how you used to throw the big bags of coffee up, they had some sort of a little call? Yeah, yeah, sure, but...
